title: Book Three · Chapter 145: The Visitor Sheet
story:
On Monday, Anna brings a new visitor sheet to school.

She wrote to the design school a few weeks earlier. Now she has the date for a winter visit.

“The first Saturday of the holiday,” she tells Ronan.

He looks at the page. The rooms open at eleven. Visitors can see class work and ask questions until three.

Anna has drawn a line under the time.

“The teachers will be there too.”

Anna takes out the drawing of the stair. She has drawn a small question mark beside the top step.

“I want to ask about this part,” she says. “It still looks wrong.”

“We can take the early bus,” Ronan says.

She looks up at him. “You want to come?”

“Yes. We can see the rooms.”

He looks at the picture below the words. There is a long table with models along one side.

Then he remembers the three work dates.

“Wait,” he says. “I need to check something.”

He takes his notebook out. The last date is the same Saturday.

Anna watches him read it.

“Work?”

“Nine until twelve. I agreed on Friday.”

She looks down at her page again.

“The morning bus gets there about ten. A later one may miss most of the visit.”

Ronan nods. He cannot make both mornings fit on the page.

“I need to talk to Mr Sun.”

“When?”

“Tomorrow after school.”

Anna turns the visitor sheet over. The school asks for visitors' names by the following Monday. There is no charge for the visit, but each person needs a confirmed place.

“My mum wants to see it too,” she says. “I will ask her about that date.”

Ronan looks at the space for names. He has nearly put both of them there in his head.

“Don't send mine yet.”

Anna nods and puts the page inside her notebook.

For a little while, they eat lunch quietly. Then she asks him to look at the small room picture.

“This is the work I want to see.”

He looks at the models and asks about one open roof. She shows him the walls beneath it.

Ronan follows her finger. He wants to stand beside that table with her. He also sees the work date still open in his own notebook.

At the bell, he writes Mr Sun beside tomorrow afternoon. Anna takes her visitor sheet to show Lin. Ronan clears his lunch box and puts the notebook where he can find it after school.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

visitor＝参观者；confirm＝确认；charge＝收费；model＝模型。

## 理解问题

1. 参观与Ronan已答应的哪一段工作冲突？双方名字已经报上去了吗？
2. Anna需要在什么时候前提交名字？Ronan答应先做哪件具体的事？

## 读句子

**Don't send mine yet.**

拆开看：Don't send / mine / yet.

先不要提交／我的名字／现在还不能确认。
